fields.title: Show when the source folder cannot be reached, with a one-press Retry
fields.description: A library banner, with the same text as the corrected toast, while the source folder cannot be reached or a folder sync fails; each Retry press makes exactly one guarded sync attempt, no background retry; clears on any successful reachable sync and restarts the watcher without a toast. partial-read stays log-only.
fields.notes: Created 2026-10-15 by Blurby.Roadmap. Owner decision (option C, both; "button tries only once. No infinite loop") relayed by Blurby.Brain, with Brain's technical rulings. After FOLDER-UNREACHABLE-GUARD-1 and LARGE-FOLDER-SYNC-2. Not a release gate. Shared core: three optional lines in src/types.ts. Full Spec: U9/U10 pass.
